chunks: My father and the group of my scholars narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Harun ibn Muslim, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Ash'ath, from 'Abdillah ibn Hammad al-Ansari, from 'Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him say: The grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is twenty cubits by twenty cubits, square, a garden from the gardens of Paradise... and he mentioned the hadith.
And from him (the narrator) from Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha', from Is'hak ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), similarly.

key_terms.قَبْرُ الْحُسَيْنِ (ع): The grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What are the dimensions and spiritual status of the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes the physical dimensions of Imam al-Husayn’s (peace be upon him) grave as twenty by twenty cubits, identifying it as a 'garden from the gardens of Paradise' (rawdatun min riyan al-jannah). This description underscores the theological significance of the site in Shia tradition, where the grave is not merely a burial place but a sacred locus of divine presence and spiritual elevation, often linked to the concept of *Barzakh*. The dual transmission chains highlight the reliability of this specific measurement within the scholarly tradition of ziyarat.
